question: Should stale Discord-backed session rows be removed automatically, exposed through an operator or agent cleanup action, or handled under the broader Dashboard prune workflow?
rationale: All viable paths mutate persistent session state and need maintainer policy for Discord 403 versus 404, archive state, startup/network cost, agent permissions, and transcript retention.

options.title: Plugin-owned preview/apply cleanup
options.body: Add a Discord-owned reachability check that previews stale candidates, revalidates immediately before deletion, and applies cleanup through sessions.delete lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Dashboard prune first
options.body: Keep agents read-only for now and implement the broader explicit Dashboard prune flow so humans approve destructive cleanup candidates.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup only
options.body: Continue supporting only selected operator deletion and generic CLI cleanup, and decline automatic Discord orphan cleanup until safer signals exist.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned preview/apply cleanup
recommendation.body: Add a Discord-owned reachability check that previews stale candidates, revalidates immediately before deletion, and applies cleanup through sessions.delete lifecycle semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal across session maintenance policy, agent-visible session tools, and recent Discord/session code.
